label: Start instance infra
description: Bring up one instance's copy of a `@per_instance` infra node; `done` fires once it answers, so the instance's triggers reading it can be activated next. The run waits without holding a worker; a copy that fails to come up fails the node with the reason; an already-running copy is left as is. If you want to answer a caller fast (a route replying 202), turn `waitUntilRunning` off and reply after this node: it finishes as soon as weft accepts the start, and a status read right after shows the copy as `provisioning`.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The `@per_instance` infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: waitUntilRunning
inputs.label: Wait until running
inputs.description: On: `done` fires once the copy runs, and a copy that fails to come up fails the node. Off: `done` fires once weft accepts the start (a start refused for a passing reason, such as a build in progress, is asked again until it is), and whether the copy then comes up is for a status read to tell.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the copy is running, or once weft accepted the start when `waitUntilRunning` is off.

then.message: StartInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
